key_decisions: Register hinge is unmarked: the dream onset at S02->S03 is a hard cut (annotated match_cut), carried by the sound drain and S03's in-shot grade ramp — a dissolve there was considered and rejected as announcing what SUP-001 and color_script require to stay invisible.

Scale is directed off five built-set gauges (glass table 0.715 m, doors 1.95 m, lamp row 2.30 m, vault 2.80 m, little door 0.38 m); every size beat must show Alice against at least two of them in one frame.

Camera-height law descends across the episode and drops below 1.0 m at the first frame of S08 and stays there — the only way giant Alice (2.74 m) and color_script act 5's 'lamps out of frame' (lamp line 2.30 m) are both true. Last visible lamp fixture in the episode is S07's vault knock.

The dream White Rabbit is directed as a quadruped (sits back on his haunches for the watch), overriding the H2-waived character sheet that stands him upright; corrective wording is mandatory in every S04/S08 prompt group.

S08 movement 4 has four required shots in fixed order (glove fits / table taller / fan still waving as the table rises / shrinking stops when the fan stops) — without them the flung fan is unmotivated, and narration is off.
POV is reserved for desire: exactly seven POV shots, listed exhaustively.
Required S03 grouping A/B/C so the two dissolves have group boundaries to attach to.
Continuity ruling: Alice still wears the single white kid glove in S10; it and the drifting fan are the only white objects in the water.
